data.name: Horrible Blow
data.description: If you have performed your daily obedience, once per day, you can inflict a debilitating disease upon your target through your weapon. You must declare your use of this ability before you roll your attack. On a hit, the target is affected as if the subject of horrid wilting cast by a wizard of level %1, as well as normal weapon damage. If you miss with your attack, the use of this ability is wasted.|min(20,TL)
